Only the numbers and short labels needed to identify each item are recorded here; obtain the laboratory's permission before publishing anything further from it.

engine_support: arecanut is NOT in the engine's crop catalog (oil palm, rice, maize, sugarcane, banana, coconut); a rule cannot be activated for it until the catalog, targets and bases are added and reviewed

recommendation_section.publication_status: The card says the recommendation comes from 'State Agricultural Universities' but names no publication, edition, page or state. It is therefore NOT traceable and cannot be approved as a source.
recommendation_section.stated_scope: 'THE FERTILIZER RECOMMENDATION SHOWN IN THIS REPORT IS FOR A FULL SEASON OF THE SELECTED CROP.'

derived_by_arithmetic_not_authoritative.method: printed kg/ha x nominal label grade (DAP 18-46-0, SSP 16% P2O5, MOP 60% K2O, urea 46% N)
derived_by_arithmetic_not_authoritative.observation: Both combinations deliver the same nutrients (about 200 N : 60 P2O5 : 140.7 K2O kg/ha) and the phosphate product quantities are exactly 60 kg P2O5 divided by the product's P2O5 grade. So this laboratory's doses are computed on the OXIDE basis for fertilizer. That is consistent with the label convention, but it does not say which basis its soil-test values are on.
derived_by_arithmetic_not_authoritative.caveat: The printed quantities do not visibly depend on the sample's measured values (N 211, P 23.46, K 319 kg/ha); whether they were adjusted for the soil test is not stated.
